dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Fresh syndication repeated the preliminary U.S. intelligence assessment that Iran's new leader may be more inclined to pursue a weapon, but no order, weapons-grade enrichment, breakout-hardware movement, atomic detonation, NPT withdrawal, or inspector-status change was verified. Raw 49; Iran-war coupling +7 => 56

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Al Jazeera reports a peaceful night in major Iranian cities and continuing mediated messages, but Tehran and Washington remain divided over who controls transit routes. CENTCOM said it disabled a tanker on Friday after warnings during the U.S. port blockade. No formal Iranian closure order, mine deployment, or literal zero-traffic condition was verified. Raw/coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Washington channel and the reported ceasefire remain the main constraints. No fresh Hezbollah strategic attack, mass-casualty event, or collapse of Israel-Lebanon contacts surfaced in the rolling review. Raw 81; Iran coupling +10 => 91

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: No verified Turkish combat entry, force movement toward Iran, official nuclear-doctrine shift, or long-range launch surfaced in the rolling 24-hour review. Raw/coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Newly indexed Kargil and security-doctrine material was retrospective. No fresh Line of Control exchange, Indian force movement, or India-Pakistan strike was verified. Raw/coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Tank district bombing and Taliban rebuttal to Pakistani accusations remain the main items. No fresh Pakistan-Afghanistan state-on-state border strike, crossing closure, or sustained interstate clash was verified. Raw/coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP reports 14 deaths across Russian and Ukrainian attack claims and says President Zelenskyy warned intelligence pointed to possible Russian preparations for a large strike within 48 hours. No direct NATO entry or nuclear-use preparation was verified; the active-war lane remains near ceiling. Raw/coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Romania's Defence Ministry confirmed an F-16 downed a second drone near the Ukrainian border in an unpopulated area and said the investigation and Allied coordination continue. Romania's foreign minister called two incursions in 48 hours a pattern; the European Council president commended the response. No second-drone attribution or Article 4/5 consultation was announced. Raw 51; Russia-Ukraine coupling +10 => 61

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new Taiwan quarantine, blockade declaration, amphibious mobilization, or military clash surfaced; current reporting remained preparedness and policy material. Raw 24; North Korea coupling +4 => 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reporting about possible KN-23 transfers to Russia remains a single claim chain. No fresh DPRK launch, atomic detonation, or major Korean Peninsula force movement surfaced. Raw/coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: North Kordofan and El Obeid danger remain acute, but no newer strategic advance around El Obeid, el-Fasher, or Port Sudan surfaced after the prior review. Raw/coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: The mass detentions, raids, movement restrictions, settlement response, and deadly West Bank clash remain the latest verified threshold. No distinct post-12Z mass-casualty or wider-uprising event surfaced. Raw/coupled 96

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: Regional reporting continued to discuss Sudan-South Sudan contacts and election risk, but no fresh military clash, verified large force movement, or Abyei security shift surfaced. Raw/coupled 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: Renewed M23-Wazalendo clashes and documented reinforcement remain the latest threshold. No independent confirmation of the claimed mass recruitment, new strategic capture, or direct Rwanda-DRC clash surfaced. Raw/coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Ahram/AFP and Yemeni military sources report government strikes on Houthi missile launch sites and depots in Marib and Al-Jawf, alleged fighter deaths, and a call for increased preparedness, after Houthi missiles and drones targeted Saudi Aramco sites. The verified expansion to front-line launch sites activates military_buildup and raises the lane four points. Raw/coupled 80 => 84

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: Bellingcat's geolocation of Shahed-type attacks and likely Russian support remains the latest threshold. No new casualty toll, confirmed operator identity, or strategic JNIM seizure surfaced. Raw/coupled 39

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Fresh indexing still describes the already-counted second straight day and third faceoff of the week, not a distinct fourth encounter. No casualty, vessel loss, or treaty consultation surfaced. Raw/coupled 27

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reporting still places M/T Asana under pirate control. No rescue, new hijacking, casualty, or naval engagement was verified in the rolling review. Raw/coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTHERN THAILAND
dashboard_trackers.notes: Expanded security measures and the Malaysia-border fencing plan remain active. No new attack, province expansion, or confirmed cross-border spillover surfaced. Raw/coupled 25

dashboard_trackers.name: KUWAIT IRAQ BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: Kuwait's interior minister said Abdali will reopen to passenger and trade traffic within 48 hours despite Thursday's drone damage; Iraqi and Kuwaiti officials stressed stability and continued bilateral movement. The reopening commitment reduces near-term border-disruption risk by two points, while the verified strike signal remains active. Raw/coupled 21 => 19
